justification: Standard: a new check script and a new data-quality row. Not Minor: it adds a ledger row that will turn the ledger red by itself after 30 days. Not Critical: it only reads (the age check is offline; the compare reads the lot table with a read-only connection and the live state maps) and changes no served answer.

pre_impl.existing_data: data/law/maps holds 8 layer files read on 2026-11-18 with hash and count in the manifest. The reader stops using the copy after 45 days. Six layers are read from it first since #1672.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: I first planned a scheduled job that downloads and commits the refresh. The project's pattern is the data-quality ledger, which a daily external alarm already runs, so the refresh is a reminder row plus a documented three-step refresh, not a new scheduler.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: download_map_layers.py already makes the copy; services/lmr_map_copy.py already enforces 45 days. This adds the missing alarm 15 days earlier and the sampled agreement check, as one script.
pre_impl.external_source_error: The age check uses no network. The compare treats a live no-answer as no answer, never as a difference, and a copy no-answer fails it.
pre_impl.frontend_type: Not applicable: no page or frontend type changes.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: A planner is served a stale copy. The reader already stops using it at 45 days and the answer names the copy date; this row turns red at 30 days so the copy is refreshed before that.

falsifiable_check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_check_map_copy.py -q ; python scripts/lmr_area/check_map_copy.py ; python scripts/lmr_area/check_map_copy.py --compare 50
falsifiable_check.fails_when: The copy is 30 days old or more, dated in the future, or any layer fails its hash or count; with --compare, a difference the reader would not send to the live map.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Four deliberate breaks of the check (age ignored, integrity ignored, future date accepted, off by one on the reminder day) each failed a test.
falsifiable_check.observed_green: 6 tests pass. The age check passes on the real copy (3 days old, 8 of 8 layers prove). The compare on 50 random lots x 6 layers found 600 agreements and 0 differences. The ledger run shows DQ-153 passing; its one red row, DQ-113, is not from this change. Two real-layer tests (database sample of 8 lots with closed outlines; a 6-lot real compare against the live maps) pass with both real flags on, not skipped.

functions.name: age_and_integrity
functions.input: today's date and the folder holding the saved maps
functions.output: whether the copy is fresh and every layer proves, with one line per problem
functions.if_none: a missing or unreadable manifest returns not ok with the reason, never ok

functions.name: compare
functions.input: the number of random lots to sample and a seed
functions.output: agreement counts and any difference the reader would not send to the live map
functions.if_none: too few lots sampled or a copy no-answer returns not ok; a live no-answer is counted but not a difference

values.read_at: WARN_DAYS in scripts/lmr_area/check_map_copy.py, 30 days, 15 days before the reader's 45

queries.purpose: Random lots with their outlines for the compare
queries.where_clause: TABLESAMPLE of lot_search_index with a fixed seed, LIMIT 3 x the number wanted; read-only connection, 30 s limit; used only with --compare

break_it.scenario: Nobody refreshes the copy for 30 days.
break_it.what_happens: The reader would stop using it at 45 days and fall back to the live map silently.
break_it.how: The ledger row goes red at 30 days, 15 days earlier, and the freshness alarm already runs the ledger every day.

break_it.scenario: A layer file is damaged or edited.
break_it.what_happens: A wrong map would answer or the layer would silently stop.
break_it.how: The check fails on any layer whose hash or feature count does not match the manifest and names the layer.

break_it.scenario: The manifest date is wrong or in the future.
break_it.what_happens: A copy would look fresher than it is.

break_it.scenario: The state service changes a map after the copy was read.
break_it.what_happens: A lot could be cleared by the copy while the live map flags it.
break_it.how: The 50-lot compare at each refresh fails on any difference the reader would not send to the live map.

break_it.scenario: The random lots with their outlines for the compare are too few or are all in one area.
break_it.what_happens: The compare would pass because it looked at too little to see a difference.
break_it.how: The compare fails when fewer lots than asked for come back, and the sample is a table-wide random sample with a recorded seed so a run can be repeated.

post_merge.manual_verify: python scripts/dq_check.py shows DQ-153 passing; it turns red by itself when the copy reaches 30 days (2026-12-18).
